name: com.funciara/docs
title: Funciara.com guides
description: Search and read the published Funciara.com guides on Romanian land-registry documents.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the published Funciara.com guides by topic and get their slugs, titles and short summaries. Use it to find which guide answers a question; use read_doc to read one.

query.description: What to look for, in Romanian or English keywords, for example "extras carte funciara pret".

limit.description: Most results to return, 1 to 10. Default 5.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read one published guide as markdown, by its slug from search_docs. Use it after search_docs; it does not search.

slug.description: The guide slug, for example the last part of https://funciara.com/ghid/<slug>.
